title: Offered Milwaukee's Wisconsin Ballroom and falling gravely ill
summary: Carl Dunbar brings him to Milwaukee, but on opening night he collapses with intestinal flu and a near breakdown and stays with Dunbar a month.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: That was up on that -- the Wisconsin River.

Yeah - the Wisconsin River, and it seems like bad luck was following me around a little bit about that time; I went--- we organized this very good band rehearsed it and I had never been sick a day in my life at this point and the first night of the opening, I got something terribly wrong with my stomach and found out I had intestinal flu -- and part of a nervous breakdown and it hit me all at once. And, so, I went --- I had no money and here I just opened up -- well, all the bad luck I was having - all at once at this particular time. So, Carl said -- well, you're going to have to stay in my room and I was in his room about four weeks---
Oh, yeah -- I was very sick -- oh, man, I lost weight -- I looked like a pencil when I got out of that bed. And, so---
And, Carl was the only one to take care of you---
Yes and he did a hell of a job---
He brought you stuff and everything else---
